$comment: Work graph for the GoodSport v2 PR. Nodes are work packages; dependsOn edges are hard contract dependencies. Build order = topological sort (ties alphabetical). estimate is relative size for the critical path.

decisions.persistence: Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Storage) behind the TeamRepo interface. Migrations, RLS policies, and security-definer functions live in supabase/migrations; the JSON file repo stays for unit tests and seeding. Chosen over Neon + Drizzle + homegrown sessions after the scored review in docs/reviews/05-identity-platform.md: a solo maintainer should not own OTP/session code guarding children's contacts, and RLS gives a second enforcement layer that pgTAP can test.
decisions.identity: Identity is a person, not a team credential. Supabase Auth email OTP / magic link for coaches and admins (no passwords, no SMS). One profiles row per auth user; org_memberships (org_admin) and team_memberships (head_coach | assistant_coach | team_parent). Parents: coach-texted family links create an anonymous auth user bound to a household; email OTP upgrades it to a full profile so one person can be a coach on one team and a parent on another. Legacy COACH_PASSCODE stays as a shim until both current coaches have signed in. Authorization: one SQL role lattice (has_team_role) used by every RLS policy and by the TypeScript requireRole guard.
decisions.snack: Generic Signup slots (role: snack) so volunteer sign-ups come free later; one slot per game; parent claim requires a household session; coach can assign/clear anything.
decisions.branching: Single developer, single branch: the swarm builds directly on the deploy branch. Every node must leave the site working (its acceptance includes existing pages rendering identically), builders commit locally, and a node is pushed only after its verifiers pass, so production only ever receives verified commits.
decisions.testing: docs/TESTING.md is binding. Every acceptance item maps to an automated test in the matching layer; the tests verifier fails a node otherwise.
decisions.parents: Phone-only families use the family link; no SMS provider. The public parent page stays open by share link; identity is only for writes and private data.
decisions.offseason: Supabase free tier pauses after 7 idle days. Start on Free with a keep-alive cron (GitHub Actions every 3 days hitting /api/keepalive); move to Pro the month a second org or photo storage arrives.

verifiers.title: Contracts
verifiers.instructions: Confirm every listed export exists at the stated path with the stated name, is consumed by at least one caller or test, and that predecessors' exports are imported rather than redefined. grep is your friend.

verifiers.title: Checks
verifiers.instructions: Run npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build on the node's commit. Confirm new pure logic has unit tests and each new route handler or server action has at least one request-level test. Fail on any skipped or focused test.

verifiers.title: Security
verifiers.instructions: Check every new write path for server-side authorization (requireRole / requireHousehold) before any read of private data; zod validation on all inputs; no PII (guardian phone/email, DOB, medical, full child last name) in public routes, public DTOs, client component props, logs, or commits; rate limits where docs/reviews/03-security.md requires them; secrets only from env. Fail with file:line.

verifiers.title: Simplicity
verifiers.instructions: Start the app (npm run build && npx next start) and load the node's screens at 400px and 1280px with Playwright (executablePath /opt/pw-browsers/chromium). Check docs/reviews/01-design-ux.md section 4 for the affected audience: tap targets >=48px, undo not confirm dialogs, no developer copy (file paths, env var names) outside Settings, primary action visible without scrolling on phone, works with keyboard focus visible.

verifiers.title: Reuse
verifiers.instructions: grep the diff for sport-specific branching (soccer, goal, pitch, quarter) in components, actions, or prompts. New behavior must read from SportTemplate. Confirm the tball template still renders every touched screen without errors.

nodes.title: Supabase foundation: schema, RLS, repository interface, seed import
nodes.goal: Stand up the Supabase project as the runtime store behind a TeamRepo interface without changing any page's behavior. Schema and RLS as SQL migrations, the role lattice function, the contact-free public_team RPC, two server-only clients (RLS client and admin client), and an idempotent import of data/teams/*.json plus the private overlay. Keep the JSON file repo for unit tests and local fallback.
exports: supabase/migrations/0001_schema.sql: tables orgs, seasons, teams, share_codes, players, player_private, households, guardians, player_guardians, events, signups, profiles, org_memberships, team_memberships, household_members, invites, audit_log; RLS enabled on every table; grants revoked from anon/authenticated on private tables

supabase/migrations/0002_auth.sql: role_rank(text), has_team_role(team uuid, min_role text) security definer, public_team(code text) security definer returning allowlisted JSON, claim_family_link(token text)
src/lib/supabase/server.ts: createServerClient with getAll/setAll cookies, httpOnly, used by server components, route handlers, actions, proxy

src/lib/supabase/admin.ts: secret-key client, import allowed only in scripts/import-seed.ts, src/actions/invites.ts, src/actions/account.ts, src/app/api/keepalive/route.ts (ESLint no-restricted-imports)

src/lib/data/repo.ts: interface TeamRepo { listTeamSlugs; loadTeam(slug,{includePrivate}); loadTeamByShareCode(code); saveEvent; deleteEvent; saveSignup; getSignups(teamId); rotateShareCode; appendAudit } with SupabaseRepo and JsonFileRepo; getRepo() selects by DATA_BACKEND=supabase|fs (fs when NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL unset)
scripts/import-seed.ts: npm run db:import, idempotent on stable ids, generates a random share code and prints it once
src/app/api/keepalive/route.ts: token-guarded select for the offseason cron
acceptance: With NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL unset, every existing page renders identically (HTML snapshot of /team/tottenham-fall-2026 and /t/<code> before and after).
Against the local Supabase stack, npm run db:import then the same pages render identically from the database.
The contract suite passes for JsonFileRepo and SupabaseRepo.

pgTAP: every public table has RLS enabled; anon is denied on guardians and player_private; public_team output contains no email, phone, DOB, or full child surname; a test greps the built client chunks for the secret key prefix and finds none.
netlify.toml build command unchanged (npm ci && checks && build); migrations are applied by supabase db push from CI on the deploy branch.

nodes.title: Identity: Supabase Auth, profiles, memberships, requireRole
nodes.goal: Per-person identity with Supabase email OTP / magic link (no passwords). One profiles row per auth user created by trigger; org_memberships and team_memberships with roles org_admin, head_coach, assistant_coach, team_parent; a single requireRole guard backed by has_team_role; Team.coaches[] replaced by memberships; a legacy COACH_PASSCODE shim so current coaches keep working during migration.

src/lib/auth/session.ts: requireRole(teamId, 'org_admin' | TeamRole | 'any_coach') -> Actor; calls rpc has_team_role; throws notFound() on failure (no 403, no enumeration)
src/lib/auth/legacy.ts: passcode shim producing a synthetic head_coach actor flagged kind: 'legacy' while COACH_PASSCODE is set
src/proxy.ts: Node runtime; matcher /team/*, /admin/*, /me/*, /api/ai/*; auth.getClaims(); redirect to /login?next= (safeNext); refreshed cookies; Cache-Control private, no-store
src/app/login: email -> 6-digit code or link; POST /api/auth/logout revokes the session; 'Sign out everywhere' uses the admin API
Actor type with label snapshot for audit rows
acceptance: Returning coach: /login -> email -> 6-digit code (link in the same email) -> session cookie; rate limited per email and IP; wrong code and expired code give generic errors.

Seeded profile with head_coach on team A gets 404 on team B; org_admin passes on both; assistant_coach cannot read player_private medical notes without the toggle permission; team_parent cannot call AI routes.
Team.coaches[] is removed from the data model and every page renders coaches from memberships.
Legacy shim: with COACH_PASSCODE set, the existing gs_coach cookie still works and audit entries carry actor.kind='legacy'; with it unset, the shim is inert.
Request tests: OTP login, wrong code, cross-team access, logout, sign-out-everywhere; pgTAP matrix for memberships and profiles tables.

nodes.goal: Give each family an identity without a password: a coach-texted family link that signs the phone in anonymously and binds it to the household, plus an email OTP claim that upgrades the same session to a full profile. A signed-in coach who is a parent elsewhere needs no second sign-in.
